summary: Residential kerb with houses 5-9m away all along it; steep.

best_section.where: Prospect Terrace north kerb, below the wooded block midway

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit 5-9m from the kerb at 8, 18, 34, 57, 77, 97, 117, 134 and 157m. The wooded gap near 35-60m still has houses within 6-7m at either end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, only a few cars parked along the north kerb; room looks tight beside trees and fences.
drivers.convention: No parking signs here, but no convention of kerbside overnight parking either.

flags: Dwellings within 10m along the whole stretch
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the north side from 20-65m; shade from the north and east.
